about: Shared by tests/test_book_metadata.py and Android BookMetadataParityTest: header fields read from the top of a TXT. A summary ends at a chapter heading, another header key, a Markdown section, a scene break or two blank lines, and never runs past the 64-line header window. 'filler' lines (count) are appended after 'text' to stand for a story without chapter headings. Each case also runs through the real import paths (Python import_text + from_sources, Kotlin BookImport.importFile), not only the parser. 'folderCases' are TXT folders imported through the real folder paths (Python import_text(folder) + from_sources, Kotlin TextImports.stageFolder + prepare): a sidecar next to the files wins, otherwise the header of the first file in natural order.
fillerLine: Dòng số {n} của một truyện không có tiêu đề chương.
